verdict.comment: The suggestion is IMPERIAL QUARTER, who looks interesting on her peak form. Charlotte's Web ties in with that filly.

comments.charlottesweb: Each-way possibilities provided she's as effective back on turf and back at 1m
comments.cheshiredancer: Ran well in Royal Ascot handicap last time but this looks a much stiffer task
comments.francophone: Ran creditably in first-time cheekpieces dropped back to 1m at Royal Ascot
comments.gaietymusical: Yet to win on turf and has the worst chance at the weights
comments.imperialquarter: Only 1-10 but is interesting on her peak effort (behind a Group 1 filly)
comments.juliaaugusta: On a long losing spell; addition of tognue-tie needs to make a difference
comments.royaldress: Major contender in this field, provided the removal of hood doesn't backfire
comments.soprano: Very useful filly; commands respect, even with 3lb penalty, back in this grade
comments.sparksfly: Excellent strike-rate on softer than good; leading contender on the figures
comments.tropicalisland: Possibly flattered in this grade over 7f on AW last week
comments.vicario: Ran respectably upped to 1m last time but has plenty to find

races.raceComment: sparksfly is marginally preferred with a score of 54.2%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions over soprano. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 5 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 11/23 at pontefract. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: There could still be further progress to come from MUSICAL TOUCH, who is first choice ahead of in-form Rousing Encore.

comments.aleezdancer: Good chance if proving resurgent; defied a higher mark at York last term
comments.badri: Close third at Epsom in sole turf outing this year; well treated on peak form
comments.cityhouse: Came up short in the Wokingham last time but this is less demanding
comments.musicaltouch: Generally progressive; possibly hasn't reached his ceiling yet; still of interest
comments.puresttime: Three wins in France; down the field in both runs for new stable
comments.rohaan: On a long losing sequence but holds a fighting chance off current mark
comments.rousingencore: Did well to finish fourth at Epsom last time; commands respect in current form
comments.spangledmac: Scored in Bahrain in January; hasn't won a British contest since 2023

races.raceComment: rousingencore is marginally preferred with a score of 54.6%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more reliable profile over rohaan. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Only four of these can be seriously fancied and EDVARD GRIEG (nap), who has no issues with turf or this trip, is the most solid option.

comments.bramblejelly: Well held on her last three starts, including when back on the Flat in January; risky
comments.edvardgrieg: Off the mark (1m4f; career-low mark) last time; back up 5lb but he's still respected
comments.latrinite: Her two handicaps have not gone well and the cheekpieces need to prompt a big turnaround
comments.maruna: Struggled in handicaps and no great improvement in a course classified (1m2f) last time
comments.missdandylion: Won first race (1m2f) last time; promises to stay new trip; one of the more likely ones
comments.monkmoorpip: Close third at Kempton (1m3f, AW) last time and he's a player if as effective on turf
comments.senseofentitlement: Finished last when tried in cheekpieces then blinkers the last twice; visor given a whirl
comments.shoplocal: Beaten 15l on her stable debut (1m) and this new trip is unlikely to help on breeding
comments.velvetvulcan: Won a 1m4f AW classified here last February but it's been downhill since; others preferred
comments.walkthemoon: Not running badly on the Flat prior to a poor hurdle run; Oisin Murphy takes over; chance

races.raceComment: bramblejelly is marginally preferred with a score of 46.5%, holding clear edges in superior course form over missdandylion. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.abstract: AW winner here in 2023; little to show for recent efforts; made respiratory noise latest
comments.captainbrett: Off the mark over 1m6f at Yarmouth; up 6lb and in trip; this is another uncompetitive race
comments.charlesmorin: Sole win at 1m1f here in 2024; not the strongest finisher beyond that distance; new trip
comments.cherrycola: Multiple wins at up to 1m6f; also placed in two C&D starts and has fallen to lowly mark
comments.flamingorose: Won Southwell bumper in 2021; well beaten in AW handicaps; off for over 3 years; new yard
comments.izakaya: Glimmer of ability in a bumper; modest in qualifying runs; may do better in handicaps
comments.silkandsteel: Minor Flat form; won recent hurdle debut; can improve in only his second Flat handicap
comments.smith: Seven AW wins, the latest in December; rarely runs on turf; well beaten in two C&D runs

races.raceComment: smith is marginally preferred with a score of 44.1%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and superior course form over captainbrett. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Soft ground from 6 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

comments.nelsonmuntz: Has run well fresh but likely place claims at best here

comments.seolinn: Smart bumper mare underwhelming so far on the Flat but worth another chance
comments.yesouisi: Struggling in handicaps but place claims back in maiden company on best form of last year

races.raceComment: seolinn is confidently preferred with a score of 54.7%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and more progressive and more reliable profile over jeaniemacaroney. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 3 wins from 7 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 3/8 at tramore-. verdict.comment: Quite an open-looking fillies handicap in which a chance is taken on STAR MIND staying the trip

comments.fratas: Just edged out of third by No Niki No at Ballinrobe; should be thereabouts again
comments.inchiquinstar: Didn't seem to stay 2m latest; drop back in trip could suit so don't rule out
comments.ladameblanche: Probably needed recent Curragh comeback run; drops in class here
comments.leitzel: Has been hurdling in recent years, of limited appeal back on the Flat
comments.nonikino: Ballinrobe run encouraging and front-running style could suit here
comments.oriole: Both runs this term over an inadequate 1m; more expected of now back at more suitable trip
comments.starmind: Strong-finishing second over shorter trips of late; big player if she stays

races.raceComment: nonikino is marginally preferred with a score of 50.0%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over fratas. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 7 wins from 25 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: A hopeful vote goes to SPINNING WEB who was consistent on the Flat in 2023 and won twice over fences earlier this year.

comments.abelmabel: Modest Flat form, outran 100-1 odds when fourth in a maiden hurdle at Clonmel last time.
comments.anjah: Off the mark at Dundalk last autumn on 34th start, may have needed the run at Sligo in May
comments.arthursvictory: Last five runs have been over hurdles, best Flat form in Britain at 7f/1m
comments.beerwiththeboys: Good run at Sligo on seasonal debut, needs to bounce back from Tipperary failure
comments.dolcefarniente: First reserve, reported in-foal and appears to be thriving, big chance if getting a run
comments.itsalonglongroad: Versatile veteran whose ten career wins include four at this venue, worth considering
comments.ladyleanora: 1m winner for Dermot Weld in 2021, has struggled in two runs over hurdles for this stable
comments.spinningweb: Reverts from jumps with a leading chance despite moderate AW form last winter
comments.stepdance: Signs of winning potential in four starts last August/September after joining this stable
comments.synchronize: Second reserve, best of his five runs for this stable when third in a maiden hurdle
comments.tartaraghan: Third reserve, 24-race maiden, placed six times, due to run at Ayr on Monday;
comments.tastyee: This year's Flat form provides little encouragement but it might be rash to rule her out
comments.wingedvictory: Struggled in two handicap attempts late last year, blinkers now instead of cheekpieces
comments.youplayedwell: Little apparent chance unless the addition of cheekpieces makes a big difference
comments.yourhonor: Not a bad run over hurdles last time following a moderate display on the Flat at Gowran

races.raceComment: itsalonglongroad is marginally preferred with a score of 50.7%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and more progressive over spinningweb. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Likely to be steadily run with pressure on the leader, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Apart from a poor Tipperary run, which can probably be excused, MAKAIAH has shown a level of form that gives her a leading chance

comments.curiousbride: Gets this trip well, needs to improve on the form shown in three starts on turf this year
comments.droptheanchor: Best known as a hurdler though he won a big staying prize on the Flat at Naas in 2022
comments.empressalma: Three handicap wins last season, well below that standard in three starts this year
comments.lorderskine: Recorded 12th career win in a big handicap hurdle at the Easter meeting at Fairyhouse
comments.makaiah: Progressive this season, bounced back from a below-par run when going close at Limerick
comments.missgitana: Two Flat wins in Britain, placed over hurdles for this yard, Flat form less convincing
comments.ohsocharming: Narrow winner of a 2m4f handicap hurdle at Clonmel a month ago, lightly raced on Flat
comments.sequoiaspirit: Won over hurdles last year, two of his five Flat wins came in quick succession in May 2023
comments.walkingonglass: Getting on in years but showed plenty of spark over hurdles at Punchestown last month

races.raceComment: lorderskine is marginally preferred with a score of 45.1%, holding clear edges in better ratings over walkingonglass. Won 1 of last 6 starts. verdict.comment: Recent winners Isocrate and Sovereign Star are respected but BALLYTECHNO can show the benefit of his recent chase debut.

comments.ballytechno: Useful 2m4f hurdle form; promising chase debut when trying to concede weight; major chance
comments.isocrate: Improved chase form when regaining lead at 2m4f (good) latest; back up 3lb; can do better
comments.letssailaway: Point winner; left clear for hurdle win (2m2f, good) in March; can make mark over fences
comments.nativemoon: Improved hurdle form at 2m7f in March (good); held in 3rd in May; chase debut
comments.redbridgerambler: Suited by good ground; chase win in March (2m7f); held since, including yesterday
comments.rockhouse: Two fair chase runs; not obviously ahead of his mark but adding a tongue-tie could help
comments.sovereignstar: Improved chase form when left ahead at Bangor (2m4f) in June; up 3lb; can progress
comments.thedreamgoeson: Winning chase debut at 2m3f but had hiccups since; others arrive with more momentum

races.raceComment: sovereignstar is marginally preferred with a score of 55.5%, holding clear edges in more progressive and more reliable profile over isocrate. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though returning from absence and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: A few with chances but ART OF DIPLOMACY finally came good over fences at Newton Abbot and might be capable of following up.

comments.ajpkingdom: On the right sort of mark but he'll stay okay and has a new tongue-tie fitted
comments.almazhargarde: Well-held third last time; allowed to dominate when winning time before at Ludlow
comments.artofdiplomacy: Had been expensive to follow over fences but came good in ready fashion at Newton Abbot
comments.cravenbay: Did well over hurdles for this yard but struggled quite badly in his first run over fences
comments.detellersfortune: Recent 3m winner here off 4lb lower; needs good ground so watch the weather
comments.facedmusic: Back to last winning mark but unreliable and can appear to be a hard ride
comments.hiddenheroics: Behind two of these at Stratford last time but did run well for a long way
comments.milanbridge: On a realistic mark but arrives here in a miserable run of form
comments.mygifttoyou: Solid efforts the last twice and similar sort of chance to Ajp Kingdom
comments.scarletotara: Three-time hurdle winner but out of form even before a forgettable first run over fences

races.raceComment: ajpkingdom is marginally preferred with a score of 69.9%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip over artofdiplomacy. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 5 wins from 18 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style. verdict.comment: Having justified an avalanche of support on his stable debut, there's a good chance that CRYSTAL MER (nap) can deal with the 10lb rise.

comments.ambassador: Had no excuses from the front when well behind Crystel Mer here last month
comments.battleofomdurman: Looks vulnerable off current mark unless the new tongue-tie brings him on
comments.crystalmer: Landed a gamble here on stable debut; could still be well in despite the 10lb hike
comments.holylegend: Modest handicap debut here but lightly raced and back on drier ground now
comments.lahire: Hasn't taken to chasing the last twice and he's not badly handicapped back over hurdles
comments.monticello: Showed little in a bumper and three novices for his former yard and was bought for £3,500
comments.northernrose: Left for dead by the winner at Market Rasen and faces some improvers here
comments.piecederesistance: Runner-up in a small field at Fakenham (2m, good) in June and is another 1lb lower here
comments.pittsburg: 8lb lower than for last week's chase win at Cartmel but that's more his game
comments.turpingold: Back from a long absence to go 2-2 for his new yard and it was all very easy at Huntingdon

races.raceComment: pittsburg is marginally preferred with a score of 55.7%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over ambassador. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.justjohnny: Showed a bit more at Stratford second time out but not enough to recommend here
comments.lalolita: Beaten 23l at Hexham and then finished last of the five runners at Stratford; opposable
comments.lateclaim: Flat bred and wasn't that strong through the line when beaten about 13l at Uttoxeter
comments.littleladyrock: It wasn't a strong race in which she finished second at Newton Abbot and RPR was modest
comments.manupfront: Finished just ahead of Whin Cover in a steadily run race here in late May
comments.sevarana: Well related and made a nice start on good ground at Fontwell, finishing second
comments.sonoftyran: Form of Worcester second has taken some knocks but still respected for top yard
comments.thehustler: Responded well for pressure to be beaten 7l at Southwell; can build on that
comments.whincover: Wasn't beaten far on his debut here but they didn't go much of a pace

races.raceComment: sonoftyran is marginally preferred with a score of 36.7%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over thehustler. Placed in 2 of last 2 starts.
